goals.statement: Trở thành fullstack senior biết tự ra quyết định thiết kế khi làm việc cùng AI agent

baseline.summary: Tự xây được web app fullstack (frontend, backend, database) mà không cần AI

competencies.name: Thiết kế input contract và error semantics cho CLI
Chuẩn hóa dữ liệu không đồng nhất thành UI model và thiết kế chính sách hiển thị trạng thái live

current_gaps: learning-evidence-gap: the policy text and decision record were drafted by the coding agent, so the learner's own reasoning is visible only for the dropped threshold and progress signals.
reasoning-gap: no stated reason for Brief and Steps sharing the same running signals.
system-evidence-gap: parallel tool calls in one step were not demonstrated at runtime.

not_demonstrated: Cron Doctor was stopped before any work; nothing was assessed.

independent: Chose one chip per row for Brief after the spike showed every plugin item takes 16px even when empty.
After feedback, narrowed scope with own reasons: Claude Code only, replies and errors on default rendering to save space in long reading sessions.
assisted: Chose the agent-proposed detail-level policy (Brief and Steps collapsed, Full auto-open) for compact skimming.
Shipped an installable, running plugin with icon-and-label activity steps, three detail levels and a follow pill.
Unknown and MCP tools render as a readable named step; long output stays bounded; steps stay legible on light and dark themes.
not_demonstrated: The learner's own reasoning for the activity set and provider mapping.
Checking the open/collapse policy against a concrete long-running scenario before choosing it.

gaps: learning-evidence-gap: the owned decision (card model and open/collapse policy) was proposed by the AI agent and chosen by the learner instead of being designed by the learner and stated in the task.
reasoning-gap: the open/collapse policy was justified by a general preference without testing it against a concrete user scenario such as a long-running command.

independent: Grounded the running-step policy in what Claude Code actually reports and dropped signals the plugin has no data for, with a stated reason.
Shipped waiting-for-approval, in-background, stopped and finished states that are distinguishable at Brief without clicking, and kept the clock across reload.
Kept the policy under the passphrase counterexample with a reason, and filled the missing 'killed' state.
not_demonstrated: A reason in your own words for Brief and Steps showing the same signals.
Stable, countable display when many tool calls run in parallel in one step.
Full unchanged and plugin-disable restoring defaults were not re-run in this round.

gaps: learning-evidence-gap: the policy text and decision record were drafted by the coding agent, so the learner's own reasoning is visible only for the dropped threshold and progress signals.
reasoning-gap: no stated reason for Brief and Steps sharing the same running signals.
system-evidence-gap: parallel tool calls in one step were not demonstrated at runtime.

next_action.reason: The live-state policy is mostly sound; a different context (a deploy CLI progress display where steps can be progressing, silent or hung) would show whether the learner can write and justify a live-state policy in their own words without a third iteration on the same plugin.
